ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Chapters 90:1? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Chapters 90:1 has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected Chapters 90:1 to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Chapters 90:1.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Chapters 90:1 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

5. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat and Zakatul Fitr.
   B. Use Zakat and Zakatul Fitr to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Zakat and Zakatul Fitr has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Significance of Tawhid? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Significance of Tawhid.
   B. Say Significance of Tawhid has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Significance of Tawhid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Significance of Tawhid to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

8. Which response best shows understanding of Saum ,? (1 mark)
   A. Say Saum , has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Saum , with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Saum , to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum ,.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Dimensions of Morality in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Dimensions of Morality in Islam has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam.
   D. Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Ulumul Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Ulumul Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Qur’an.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Shirk of Shirk Shirk? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Shirk of Shirk Shirk with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Shirk of Shirk Shirk has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam ? (1 mark)

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam .

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 08 6 Muamalat 6.1 Marriage 06 6.2  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
